assertions.assertion: The web_app client has AccessTokenType = AccessTokenType.Reference
The web_app client has AccessTokenLifetime set to 900 (15 minutes)
The ApiResource api1_resource has ApiSecrets with at least one Secret configured
assertions.rationale: api1_resource has ApiSecrets with a Secret.

assertions.assertion: Explains that JWT access tokens cannot be revoked (RFC 7009 revocation applies only to reference access tokens and refresh tokens), which is why reference tokens are used here for immediate revocation
assertions.rationale: States JWTs remain valid until exp unlike reference tokens revocable via /connect/revocation or grant deletion; conveys JWTs cannot be revoked early though does not cite RFC 7009 explicitly (borderline pass).
